0.reason: Command.run calls flag.PostParse() on every flag, and PostParse calls f.Set directly. Set runs PreParse, which builds a new f.value, and nothing applies setMultiValueParsingConfig in that path. The config is applied only in Command.set and Command.Set, which are the CLI-argument paths. SliceBase therefore keeps an empty separator and DisableSliceFlagSeparator=false, and flagSplitMultiValues splits on the default separator for env, file and Sources values.
